metadata.description: Plugins maintained alongside the systemd source tree: agent tooling for moving container orchestration (Docker Swarm, Compose, Podman, OCI images) onto systemd-native primitives. Each plugin is named <source>-<object>-to-<target> and its skills follow the same pattern.

plugins.name: docker-swarm-to-systemd
plugins.description: Capture a Docker Swarm estate into the shared inventory contract and plan its migration to systemd hosts.

plugins.name: oci-image-to-systemd
plugins.description: Run container images as native systemd services: pull them into mount stacks with importctl, render per-host units with RootMStack=, credentials, mounts, and health timers.

plugins.name: podman-container-to-quadlet
plugins.description: Render the inventory into per-host Podman Quadlet units, stack targets, and install scripts.

plugins.name: systemd-migration-harness
plugins.description: Verify rendered and installed units, and run the migration agents unattended on production hosts through a Managed Agents harness.
